articles.title: Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition
articles.summary: Five years after a coup ousted Myanmar's elected civilian government, Min Aung Hla Five years after mounting a coup that ousted an elected civilian government, Min Aung Hlaing has overseen tightly staged elections transitioning him from commander-in-chief to president. Foreign governments should ensure interaction with Naypyitaw is calibrated, so as not to confer unwarranted legitimacy on the administration. articles.title: Issues of War and Peace Gain Top Billing in Armenia’s Election
articles.summary: Armenians will vote in a general election on 7 June. Armenians will head to the polls on 7 June for the country’s first general election since 2021. In this Q&A, Crisis Group expert Joshua Kucera explains why foreign policy has dominated the campaign and what the results may mean for Yerevan’s external relations. Issues of War and Peace Gain Top Billing in Armenia’s Election.

articles.title: Tiny Djibouti, and Its Prime Real Estate

Tiny Djibouti, and Its Prime Real Estate.

articles.title: A New Player in the Quest for a U.S.-Iran Breakthrough
articles.summary: Pakistan began conveying proposals to end the war soon after the United States and Israel started bombing Iran on 28 February. articles.title: Bread Prices Have Doubled As Iran Faces Crushing Inflation
articles.summary: Bread prices doubled in Iran. Consumers report difficulty affording the staple food. articles.title: In Viral Post, Russian Veteran Warns Putin Of Mutiny, Then Walks Back Threat
articles.summary: A Russian veteran posted a viral video demanding a meeting with President Vladimir Putin. He warned of a potential rebellion, then later retracted his threat. This incident underscored rising tensions regarding the war in Ukraine, which has reportedly killed half a million Russian soldiers. A veteran of Russia’s war against Ukraine sparked a stir with a viral video post, demanding a meeting with President Vladimir Putin and warning of a rebellion – before retracting the threat.
